label: Microsoft 365
summary: Personal-tenant administration evidence organized by Microsoft 365 technology, task, result, proof, scope, and limitation.

technologies.label: Tenant Administration
technologies.task: Reviewed organization settings, verified domains, subscribed services, users, groups, and admin-center state.
technologies.result: A structured tenant inventory and proof map connect administrative work to reviewable exports, screenshots, and manifests.
technologies.limitations: Does not represent client, production, or enterprise-scale tenant ownership.

technologies.label: Entra ID
technologies.task: Reviewed users, groups, memberships, directory roles, devices, sign-ins, and directory audit records.
technologies.result: Identity objects and administrative relationships are preserved in structured exports with bounded claims.
technologies.scope: Read-only review and evidence capture in a personal tenant.
technologies.limitations: Does not prove large-scale lifecycle ownership or privileged production administration.

technologies.label: Security and Compliance
technologies.task: Reviewed Defender mail protections and Conditional Access evaluation, corrected an external-user policy scope issue, and validated the resulting sign-in behavior.
technologies.result: Audit and sign-in evidence show the policy update succeeded, MFA remained effective, and the external-user block no longer applied to the internal test account.

proof.label: Open the messaging and security case study

technologies.limitations: Does not prove organization-wide security assurance, production incident response, or enterprise policy ownership.

technologies.label: Applications
technologies.task: Reviewed app registrations, enterprise applications, service principals, and OAuth permission grants.
technologies.result: Application identities and delegated relationships are represented in structured evidence.
technologies.limitations: Does not prove application development, production consent ownership, or tenant-wide remediation.

technologies.label: Exchange Online
technologies.task: Configured and validated a shared mailbox with delegation, a distribution group, an enforced external-sender transport rule, and message delivery tracing.
technologies.result: PowerShell and message-trace evidence confirm the scoped Exchange objects, delegation, rule state, and delivered test messages.

proof.label: Open the messaging and security case study

technologies.limitations: Does not prove production mail-flow ownership, retention governance, enterprise-scale messaging administration, or client tenant responsibility.

technologies.label: Intune
technologies.skill: Windows Autopilot and Microsoft Intune endpoint administration
technologies.task: Registered and targeted a physical Windows endpoint, completed user-driven Microsoft Entra join and Intune enrollment through branded OOBE and ESP, deployed required Microsoft 365 Apps and security settings, and remediated Secure Boot compliance.
technologies.result: Endpoint and Intune evidence confirm Entra join, active MDM enrollment, required application deployment, BitLocker, Defender, firewall, VBS, Secure Boot, successful Settings Catalog check-in, and final compliant state.

proof.label: Open the Windows Autopilot and Intune case study

technologies.scope: One physical Lenovo endpoint in a scoped personal Microsoft 365 developer tenant pilot.
technologies.limitations: Demonstrates a controlled single-device Autopilot and Intune pilot, not production fleet ownership or enterprise-scale endpoint operations.

technologies.label: SharePoint
technologies.task: Preserved an indexed SharePoint export collection with source paths, hashes, excerpts, and curated navigation.
technologies.result: The original documentation remains inspectable without presenting exported pages as live SharePoint resources.
technologies.limitations: Does not prove administration of a live production SharePoint environment.

technologies.label: Teams
technologies.task: Documented team, channel, group, and collaboration setup concepts through preserved lab material.
technologies.result: Teams-related administration knowledge is connected to preserved source documentation.
technologies.limitations: Does not prove ownership of a live organizational Teams environment.

technologies.label: Automation
technologies.skill: Microsoft Graph and PowerShell evidence automation
technologies.task: Used read-only scripts and structured exports to capture tenant, identity, policy, application, sign-in, and audit evidence.
technologies.result: Repeatable collection workflows produce reviewable CSV, JSON, Markdown, and manifest artifacts.
technologies.scope: Verified repository scripts and documented references.
technologies.limitations: Referenced scripts are not treated as executed or authored unless the raw source is present and verified.
